note: Draft register for Spec 049 (design D-06, PR #195 packet; consumer of Asset A), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign approved by the owner as written on 2026-10-21. Conventions as in Spec 042's and Spec 045's draft registers: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-PHASE43-RECORD (the pinned hunt_tripartite_test and phase43 records are the record of the positional half and of the 40-sign opening-strong set), ASM-ASSET-A-FROZEN (Asset A will exist, frozen under Spec 045 with its SHA-256 recorded in asset-a-freeze.json, and is consumed exactly as frozen, never rebuilt or re-derived by this spec), ASM-CROSSWALK-KEYS (the pinned crosswalk and the identifiers the frozen asset itself carries define identity resolution, under the keying rule the freeze fixes), ASM-COUNT-CORPUS (occurrence counts come from the pinned corpus layer under the counting rule the freeze fixes; the draft reading, open for the freeze to confirm or replace), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (dependency, asset-pin, population, and coverage gates precede any outcome quantity), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited), ASM-PUBLISHED-ID-LAYER (a depicted-kind label is a published identification, not ground truth about the sign).

falsification_tests: the claim is falsified in scope if any Spec 049 output states a conclusion about a meaning, a different claim, or a population outside the opening-strong animal test
